channel.title: World Israel News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from World Israel News (worldisraelnews.com)

item.title: WATCH: IDF destroys Litani River bridge, Hezbollah tunnel shaft in southern Lebanon
item.description: IDF troops in southern Lebanon are operating forcefully against Hezbollah, destroying a weapons tunnel shaft and a fifth bridge along the Litani River used to transport funds and weapons.

item.title: Knesset restores right of rabbinic courts to adjudicate civil cases
item.description: Knesset passes bill expanding authority of religious courts, empowering them to rule in civil disputes after Supreme Court barred them from doing so.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, UAE mull joining US-Israel war on Iran
item.description: Under pressure from the US and reeling from Iranian attacks, Riyadh and Abu Dhabi move toward joining the US-Israeli campaign against the Islamic Republic.

item.title: Lebanon expels Iranian ambassador
item.description: Iran's envoy to Beirut declared persona non grata, ordered to leave the country by March 29 after the Iranian proxy group Hezbollah led Lebanon into another conflict with Israel.

item.title: Iran peace talks unlikely to succeed, Israel estimates
item.description: Israeli officials express skepticism regarding the prospects for a negotiated end to the current war with Iran, amid reports the US is keeping Jerusalem informed of developments in talks with Tehran.

item.title: WATCH: IDF performs over 2,000 refuelings as part of Roaring Lion
item.description: Since Operation Roar of the Lion began, the Israeli Air Force has conducted over 2,000 aerial refuelings—keeping hundreds of fighter jets continuously striking targets deep inside Iranian airspace.

item.title: Qatari opposition leader accuses Tucker Carlson of financial ties to Qatar
item.description: Sheikh Khalid Al Hail, who leads a London-based opposition group against the Qatari regime, has long accused Doha of funding influence operations in Western media and politics.

item.title: Mamdani heckled while speaking at Passover seder in Manhattan after comedian drops out
item.description: Israeli-American comedian Modi Rosenfeld was scheduled to perform at the event but pulled out last minute after learning that Mamdani was participating.

item.title: WATCH: IDF kills over 40 terrorists in south Lebanon
item.description: Over the past 24 hours, the IAF and Navy struck dozens of Hezbollah headquarters, weapons depots, launch sites, and anti-tank missile positions in south Lebanon.

item.title: Turkish intel chief hosts Hamas leaders as new report warns of Turkey’s ties to Muslim Brotherhood
item.description: Ankara has provided Hamas with both political and financial support by allowing its leadership to operate networks from Turkish soil.

item.title: UAE wishes the ‘people of Israel’ a happy Passover
item.description: The UAE signed a normalization agreement with Israel as part of the Abraham Accords in 2020, brokered by the first Trump administration.

item.title: WATCH: Hezbollah releases footage of FPV drone striking IDF tank
item.description: The Lebanese terror group Hezbollah released a video showing an explosives-laden FPV drone striking an IDF tank operating in the area.

item.title: Hezbollah fires 130 rockets at Israel, hundreds of thousands run for shelter
item.description: Two separate impacts on Thursday resulted in injuries, one in Kiryat Shmona and the other in the northern town of Bi'ina.

item.title: Vance relays Trump’s push for Iran deal, warns of pressure on infrastructure if talks fail
item.description: The message was passed through officials from Pakistan and Turkey, who have been acting as mediators between Washington and Tehran.

item.title: Amazon says cloud operations in Bahrain disrupted after Iranian threats to US companies
item.description: Iran warned that beginning April 1, it would target American companies in response to US and Israel operations in its country.
